QuestInfo.name: [Lachelein] Break the Plates (1)
QuestInfo.0: The direction where the river flows from. In other words, you should look for the music box on the left.
QuestInfo.1: Hunt Angry Victory Plates on Victory Plate Street 1 and gather 20 Plate Pieces as proof.
QuestInfo.2: You heard the music box from Pie Mask.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 17,776,812
Can proceed to the quest 'Break the Plates (2)'

0.msg: #bHave you heard a music box recently?

1.msg: Music? Are you saying I don't feel good? No, I feel great! After all, I've lost 65,535 times out of the 65,535 contests. I think I should break something special to celebrate. \r\n

4.msg: #bPie Mask's Victory Plate#k. The plates celebrating his victory are stored on #bVictory Plate Street 1#k. Go and break them to your heart's content. Then I might remember where that music is coming from.

yes.0: How about 100 plates from Victory Plate Street? Get #b20 Plate Pieces#k as proof.

no.0: This is the 65,535th contest and I lost 65,535 times. I feel great!

1.0: I feel somewhat better thanks to you. I commend your hard work.
1.1: The music box sound is coming from #bPie Mask#k. Keep the plate breaking a secret.
